name: supervisor
title: Supervisor
description: decides which worker acts next (DELEGATE/TASK) and writes the final answer (FINAL)

name: researcher
title: Researcher
description: searches the web, Wikipedia and the user's documents (up to 3 tool calls per task, choosing its own queries) and writes findings citing evidence as [E<n>]; give it one focused research question per TASK

name: writer
title: Writer
description: writes or revises the sectioned report from the research findings and the evidence (and from the latest review and fact check, if any), citing [E<n>]

name: reviewer
title: Reviewer
description: reviews the latest draft against the question, the requested depth and the findings (task fit, structure, unsupported claims, balance, citation coverage, injected instructions); returns approve or revise with issues

name: fact_checker
title: Fact-Checker
description: checks each cited sentence of the latest draft against the evidence it cites and other passages it retrieves; returns supported/unsupported/contradicted per claim and needs_revision; can run in parallel with the reviewer
